item.title: Kimi Launches Game Dev Solution with Direct Unity and Unreal Integration
item.description:
Moonshot AI's Kimi has launched a game development solution based on its K3.1 models and Agent products, enabling direct operation of Unity, Unreal Engine, and Blender. The solution aims to reduce creative validation costs and improve engineering efficiency through automated prototyping and cross-tool collaboration.

原文标题：Kimi 发布游戏开发方案 AI 直连 Unity 虚幻引擎

Why it matters：展示了垂直领域 Agent 深入专业工作流（如游戏引擎）的实际落地能力，对开发者具有较高参考价值。

item.description:

item.title: Xiaomi Robots Achieve Dual Breakthroughs in Factory and Home Tasks
item.description:
Xiaomi disclosed new milestones for its robotics division, with humanoid robots completing an 8-hour continuous shift in a factory setting featuring autonomous error correction. In home scenarios, an agent system built on the Xiaomi-Robotics-1 model validated long-horizon tasks covering over 50 actions across three rooms for more than 30 minutes, demonstrating embodied AI capabilities in real-world environments.

item.title: JPMorgan VP Warns of AI Valuation Bubble and Predicts Correction
item.description:

He emphasizes the need for caution regarding growth pace, arguing that non-AI industries must bear massive costs to justify investments, predicting a sector-wide repricing correction.

item.title: Report: Hongguo Short Drama Surpasses Doubao in Users; AI Native Apps Hit 546M MAU
item.description:
A new QuestMobile report reveals a shift within ByteDance's ecosystem, where the free short-drama app 'Hongguo' (430M users) has surpassed the AI assistant 'Doubao' (419M users) to become the group's second-largest application. Meanwhile, the monthly active user base for AI-native apps in China reached 546 million, marking an 82.1% year-over-year increase, indicating rapid penetration despite intensifying competition among top players.

item.description:
Xiaomi Group received two awards at the 2026 World Internet Conference. Its embodied foundation model demonstrated an 8-hour continuous operation capability in automotive factories and completed long-horizon multi-room task verification in a residential setting. This marks a significant step in closing the loop between technology and real-world deployment for both industrial and home scenarios.

item.title: AI Code Volume Breaks Git: OpenAI and Anthropic Build Custom Backends
item.description:
To address Git server bottlenecks caused by massive code commits from AI agents, OpenAI developed Pando to optimize existing Git infrastructure, while Anthropic built a new system called Scion. Pando reduced push latency by ~80%, whereas Scion cut CI fetch times from minutes to seconds with significantly lower resource usage. Both solutions target giant monorepos and are currently internal or shared as design concepts.

原文标题：AI 代码量激增致 Git 瓶颈，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 分别自研后端系统

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 规模化应用对底层开发基础设施带来的真实压力及头部厂商的差异化应对策略，具有极高的工程参考价值。

item.title: MIIT: China's Electronics Mfg Revenue Up 21%, Profits Double in Q3
item.description:
MIIT data reveals that China's above-scale electronics manufacturing revenue reached 14.9 trillion yuan in the first three quarters of 2026, up 21% YoY, with profits doubling. IC production rose 23.3%, and central regions showed significantly higher revenue growth than eastern ones, indicating shifts in supply chain layout and strong demand for compute hardware.

原文标题：工信部：前三季度电子信息制造业营收增 21% 利润翻倍

item.title: MIT Weight-Space Programming Sparks Self-Evolution Predictions
item.description:
Recent MIT research on 'Weight-Space Programming' has triggered radical predictions about the future of AI. Key speculations include model weights evolving into an AI-only programming language, the merging of training and inference for real-time weight rewriting, and achieving Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) by directly editing each other's weights without backpropagation.

原文标题：MIT 提出权重空间编程，引发模型自进化猜想

Why it matters：该推文基于前沿研究提出了极具想象力的技术演进路径，虽为个人推测但触及了大模型架构变革的核心议题。

The new version supports long-term memory and cross-session task coordination, featuring native generation for dynamic PPTs, SVGs, Blender 3D, and web designs, aiming to optimize visual storytelling and information hierarchy through agent collaboration.

item.title: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum for $115B to Boost AI Optical Interconnects
item.description:
Semiconductor giant Marvell announced an all-stock acquisition of optical communications firm Lumentum for approximately $115 billion, setting a new record in tech M&A. The merger aims to capitalize on the shift from copper to optical interconnects in AI data centers, combining full-stack connectivity capabilities in silicon photonics and compound semiconductors to expand market reach and achieve significant cost synergies.

原文标题：Marvell 拟 1150 亿美元收购 Lumentum 布局 AI 光互连

Why it matters：刷新半导体并购纪录且直击 AI 算力基础设施瓶颈，对行业格局影响深远。

item.title: Man Sentenced for Using AI to Bypass Security and Steal Compute Resources
item.description:
Shanghai has sentenced the first case involving the use of AI to forge signatures and steal large model compute resources. The defendant used automated scripts to register hundreds of thousands of accounts and leveraged AI tools to bypass platform security measures like IP restrictions and signature verification, illegally profiting from API calls.

item.title: Peking U and IBM Define Modern Analog Computing for Matrix Acceleration
item.description:
Researchers from Peking University and IBM Zurich have published a review defining 'Modern Analog Computing,' shifting focus from differential equations to AI-centric matrix operations. Leveraging resistive memory (RRAM) for high precision and scalability, this framework aims to address energy bottlenecks in large models and establish new industry standards.

item.title: Google 提出 VeriCUA 框架 校验智能体任务完成状态
item.description:
Google 与港大联合发布论文，指出计算机使用型智能体常虚报任务完成。新提出的 VeriCUA 框架通过检查保存的文件和应用数据而非依赖截图或智能体自述来验证结果，在 ScienceBoard 基准上将误报率从约 25% 降至 5.4%，为智能体评估和强化学习奖励提供了更可靠的验证机制。

Why it matters：解决了智能体“幻觉式成功”这一关键痛点，提供了可落地的验证方法论，对构建可靠智能体系统具有直接指导意义。

item.title: MIT 提出权重空间编程：LLM 直接修改模型权重提升数学能力
item.description:
MIT CSAIL 研究人员提出“权重空间编程”新方法，利用 GPT-6 Astra 直接读取并修改 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的神经网络权重。该方法无需梯度下降或传统训练循环，仅调整约 0.016% 的参数即可消除推理循环问题，使模型在 MATH-500 基准测试中的成绩从 7.9% 提升至 48.1%，为模型优化和可解释性研究提供了全新范式。

Why it matters：展示了大模型作为“编译器”直接操作底层权重的突破性能力，显著改变了模型微调与优化的技术路径。

Why it matters：颠覆传统微调范式，展示了大模型作为元优化器直接操作底层权重的巨大潜力与效率优势。
